<?php

class FeatureFlags {
    private string $configPath;
    private array $cache = [];
    private int $cacheTime = 0;
    private const CACHE_TTL = 5;

    public function __construct(string $configPath) {
        $this->configPath = realpath($configPath) ?: $configPath;
    }

    public function isEnabled(string $flag): bool {
        $this->refreshCache();
        return isset($this->cache[$flag]) && $this->cache[$flag] === true;
    }

    private function refreshCache(): void {
        if (time() - $this->cacheTime < self::CACHE_TTL) {
            return;
        }
        if (file_exists($this->configPath)) {
            $raw = file_get_contents($this->configPath);
            $this->cache = json_decode($raw, true) ?? [];
            $this->cacheTime = time();
        }
    }
}

class SerializationPolicy {
    private FeatureFlags $flags;
    private array $allowedClasses;

    public function __construct(FeatureFlags $flags) {
        $this->flags = $flags;
        $this->allowedClasses = ['stdClass', 'DateTime', 'DateTimeImmutable'];
    }

    public function getAllowedClasses(): array|bool {
        if ($this->flags->isEnabled('strict_deserialization')) {
            return $this->allowedClasses;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public function isStrictMode(): bool {
        return $this->flags->isEnabled('strict_deserialization');
    }
}

class SecureSerializer {
    private SerializationPolicy $policy;
    private string $hmacKey;

    public function __construct(SerializationPolicy $policy, string $hmacKey) {
        $this->policy = $policy;
        $this->hmacKey = $hmacKey;
    }

    public function serialize(mixed $data): string {
        $payload = \serialize($data);
        $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->hmacKey);
        return base64_encode($signature . '|' . $payload);
    }

    public function deserialize(string $input): mixed {
        $decoded = base64_decode($input, true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid encoding');
        }

        $separatorPos = strpos($decoded, '|');
        if ($separatorPos === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid format');
        }

        $signature = substr($decoded, 0, $separatorPos);
        $payload = substr($decoded, $separatorPos + 1);

        // Verify HMAC signature
        $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->hmacKey);
        if (!hash_equals($expected, $signature)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Signature verification failed');
        }

        // Check policy BEFORE deserialization
        $strictMode = $this->policy->isStrictMode();

        // Validate payload structure for dangerous patterns
        if ($strictMode) {
            $this->validatePayloadStructure($payload);
        }

        // Get allowed classes - this re-checks the feature flag
        // TOCTOU: flag state may have changed between isStrictMode() check above
        // and getAllowedClasses() call here if config file was modified
        $allowedClasses = $this->policy->getAllowedClasses();

        $options = ['allowed_classes' => $allowedClasses];
        return \unserialize($payload, $options);
    }

    private function validatePayloadStructure(string $payload): void {
        // Check for object markers that aren't in our allowlist
        $pattern = '/O:\d+:"([^"]+)"/';
        if (preg_match_all($pattern, $payload, $matches)) {
            $allowed = $this->policy->getAllowedClasses();
            if (is_array($allowed)) {
                foreach ($matches[1] as $className) {
                    if (!in_array($className, $allowed, true)) {
                        throw new \RuntimeException(
                            "Disallowed class in payload: $className"
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Application bootstrap
$configDir = getenv('APP_CONFIG_DIR') ?: '/etc/myapp';
$featureFlags = new FeatureFlags($configDir . '/features.json');
$policy = new SerializationPolicy($featureFlags);
$serializer = new SecureSerializer($policy, getenv('HMAC_SECRET') ?: bin2hex(random_bytes(32)));

// Example usage in request handler
if (isset($_POST['data'])) {
    try {
        $result = $serializer->deserialize($_POST['data']);
        echo json_encode(['status' => 'ok', 'type' => gettype($result)]);
    } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
    }
}
